create.name: Matt Licata
create.bio:
Matt Licata is an American author, teacher and psychotherapist whose work joins depth psychology with contemplative and embodied spirituality. He holds degrees in psychology and religion, and his doctoral research looked at how spiritual beliefs and practices can be used to steer around unresolved emotional wounds. Over some thirty years he has studied and practised in several wisdom traditions, chiefly Vajrayana Buddhism, Sufism, Daoism and contemplative Christianity, training in North America, India and Nepal, and he now describes his practice as interfaith. For many years he directed Sounds True's professional training division.

Outside the clinical practice he keeps for clients in Colorado, which is not listed here, he teaches as a spiritual guide and mentor. His recorded online courses cover shadow work, the wounded healer, tending the soul, inner guidance and resting the nervous system, and combine talks with guided meditation and imaginal practice; he also leads live online groups and occasional in-person retreats. He writes almost daily on his blog, A Healing Space, shares many free webinars, and posts short teachings and guided meditations on YouTube. His books are The Path is Everywhere (2017) and, from Sounds True in 2020, A Healing Space, on befriending ourselves when life is hard.

books.title: A Healing Space: Befriending Ourselves in Difficult Times
books.author: Matt Licata
books.description: His Sounds True book on meeting confusion, heartbreak and loss with kindness rather than trying to fix them. It weaves Jungian and alchemical ideas, contemplative practice and attachment research, and looks at how spiritual practice can be used to avoid old wounds.

books.title: The Path is Everywhere: Uncovering the Jewels Hidden Within You
books.author: Matt Licata
books.description: An earlier collection of short reflections drawn from depth and relational psychology, contemplative spirituality and poetry, on finding the path in ordinary experience.

courses.title: Alchemical Healing and Accessing the Wisdom of the Sacred Wound
courses.description: A self-study course of seven ninety-minute recorded teachings, with guided meditations and answers to common questions. It draws on the alchemical tradition and depth psychology to explore meaning, imagination and the gifts hidden in old wounds.

courses.title: Embracing the Shadow and the Path of Light
courses.description: A nine-session home-study course on meeting and integrating the shadow as part of spiritual growth. It looks at how unfelt emotion and disowned parts of ourselves shape our lives, and how spiritual ideas can be used to avoid them.

courses.title: Reclaiming the Self
courses.description: A six-session course that moves away from self-improvement towards remembering the soul. Sessions explore the body's own wisdom, grief and tenderness as part of the path, and relationship as a place of practice.

courses.title: Resting Your Nervous System
courses.description: An online course for slowing down when the work of healing and awakening has itself become tiring. It pairs teachings on listening to the body and opening the heart with rest-based practices.

courses.title: Tending to the Soul
courses.description: Five sessions, more than eight hours in all, of teachings, guided meditations and experiential practices for times when one chapter of life has ended and the next has not yet begun. The theme is a spirituality of the heart and of belonging.

courses.title: The Path of the Wounded Healer
courses.description: A five-session online course on soul work: rethinking what healing means, building an inner holding environment, working with shadow, and tending the soul through meditation, dreams and imagination, ending with close relationship as a place of healing.

courses.title: The Quiet Work
courses.description: An on-demand course on staying present with ourselves when life feels hard, without rushing to fix or bypass what we feel. It is aimed at times of uncertainty, grief and inner change.

courses.title: The Soul Alchemist
courses.description: A course on trusting inner guidance and attuning to what he calls the inner ally. It looks at transitional times as openings to a felt sense of centre and to a sacred dimension of ordinary life.

free_resources.title: Holding the Inner Child
free_resources.description: A free thirty-minute video teaching with a guided practice and a companion eBook of about fifty pages. It explores caring for younger parts of ourselves as part of healing and individuation.

free_resources.title: Return to Your Center
free_resources.description: A free thirty-minute video teaching and practice, with a companion eBook, on finding steady inner ground when life feels uncertain or overwhelming.

free_resources.title: A Place for Grief
free_resources.description: A free short eBook of eleven reflections on loss, longing and quieter kinds of sorrow, offered as companionship in hard times.

free_resources.title: Listening To Your Soul
free_resources.description: A free recorded webinar on coming back to the heart and the inner friend, and on letting uncertainty become a bridge to the soul.

free_resources.title: Ground the Body, Clear the Mind
free_resources.description: A free recorded webinar on stepping back from a sense of collective urgency, settling the senses and finding inner ground again.

flags: Health restore (owner's 12 Nov rule): earlier skipped because he presents himself as 'Psychotherapist & Author' (pipelines-sprint-3/skipped/matt-licata.json, which already suggested a rethink). His courses, free webinars, meditations and books are contemplative and spiritual (shadow, soul, inner guidance, meditation), and his Psychotherapy page says that outside Colorado he offers spiritual counselling and mentorship; listed for that work only, the clinical practice left out.
Course pages show 'introductory' or 'special' prices beside a regular price, with '$' only (no currency named); both written as published, no currency code added.
'Alchemical Healing' calls itself 'a psychotherapy of the soul'; kept because it is a recorded teaching course with guided meditations, not clinical treatment. Owner may drop it.
Personal Gmail address used as published on his Contact page (he notes he cannot answer everyone); support@mattlicataphd.com is the course support inbox.
Possible editorial-stature override: Sounds True author and former director of Sounds True's professional training division; tier not raised.
Free resources: the webinar links on /free-resources/ were matched to titles by their order and slugs; the five chosen have slugs that match their titles. The pages themselves were not opened.

Dry run not run: node scripts/ingest.mjs … --env dev was refused by this session's permission check (13 Nov 2026); the lead session should run it. All images were fetched or HEAD-checked with curl (200) instead.

Psychotherapy (Colorado residents only) and private spiritual counselling: clinical practice out of scope; the page says all private sessions are booked.
Shadow Work (six-week live online course, /shadow-work/): waitlist only, no dates or price published.

Other free webinars (Emptying the Cup, Beyond the Matrix, When the Center Is Lost, Trauma as Initiation, Turning the Light, Alchemy of the Heart, Belonging in the Broken, Remembering the Sacred, Rest the Nervous System, The Shadow and the Light): cap of 5 free resources.

YouTube Shorts and clips under ~2 minutes (e.g. 'Allowing Another Person to Matter to Us', 'All therapy is grief therapy') and 'Why Does Everything Feel So Uncertain Right Now?' (topical, not checked for political content).
Further Journeys on the Path of the Wounded Healer: announced for 2026, no ISBN on his site.
In-person retreats: mentioned on the home page, but no retreat page or dates found.
